build.command: xcodebuild -project HomeAssistant.xcodeproj -scheme App-Debug -configuration Debug -destination platform=iOS\ Simulator,id=294D96E5-D7C8-4ADF-8983-55114743857F -derivedDataPath /tmp/ts-shortcuts-ha-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO DISABLE_SWIFTLINT=1 CI=true build

installedSimulatorApp.source: Official CI artifact from the same commit

nativeReference.method: Created Set brightness in the Shortcuts editor; selected Ask Each Time for light and entered 50; read saved ZSHORTCUTACTIONS.ZDATA read-only from simulator Shortcuts.sqlite.
nativeReference.brightnessStorage: Native editor stores "50" as text; compiler emits numeric 50.

physicalDevice.note: User confirmed that the generated release shortcut works on their iPhone for light.globe at 50%. Result reported by the user, not independently observed by the agent.

simulatorImport.transport: Safari download then Files → Add Shortcut
simulatorImport.name: home-assistant-brightness-public
simulatorImport.execution: Not executed against a Home Assistant server; no lamp was changed.

releaseReference.metadataOrigin: SetBrightness schema from the recorded development build; release export confirms action and parameter keys, not installed app version.
releaseReference.personalEntityStorage: Only in ignored dist/home-assistant-globe.ts and dist/HA-Globe-50 artifacts. Shared fixture uses a synthetic entity.
